description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Altamira Technologies Corporation provides innovative technology solutions to the U.S. national security community. The Junior Software Engineer will develop full-stack software and web applications, interpret mission requirements, use continuous integration practices, and collaborate with teammates and users to build maintainable, user-friendly systems.
Junior software engineer developing user-friendly systems through requirements interpretation, design, and continuous integration

Responsibilities:
• Produce software based on desired functionality provided by users and analysts
• Interpret mission needs and requirements to produce user-friendly software systems
• Leverage continuous integration to create sustainable and maintainable software
• Interact with teammates and users through whiteboard sessions and/or design documents to establish circular feedback

Requirements:
• We are seeking Software Engineers that possess a mix of talent areas related to full stack development
• Our ideal candidate would possess a broad range of skills as our scope of work spans various technologies
• We are looking for candidates who have experience with developing and are not afraid to adapt to the right architecture, languages, and libraries to build the best systems for the mission and deliver the best user experience
• Bachelor's in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field
• Experience in one or more of the following: Java, JavaScript/Typescript, Python, Angular, ELK stack, Redis, Web Services (REST), Containerization (such as docker, lxc), Kubernetes, helm, Machine Learning, Data Analytics, Android development, NoSQL and SQL databases, Xmidas, Digital Signal Processing
• TS/SCI REQUIRED. NO EXCEPTIONS
• Self-motivated and eager to work intently to satisfy mission requirements
• Ability to effectively communicate in verbal and written communications
• Ability to multitask and adjust priorities as needed
